findings.evidence: mathlib/.../Complex/Basic.lean:663 `zero_notMem_slitPlane`; arg_annular_quotient_tendsto_right already does exactly this derivation (ChordQuotientAsymptotics.lean:217-219 `have hL : L ≠ 0 := … div_zero … zero_notMem_slitPlane`).
findings.fix: Drop hL_R and hL_L from the signature and derive them internally, e.g. `have hL_R : L_R ≠ 0 := fun h0 => Complex.zero_notMem_slitPlane (by rw [h0, div_zero] at h_slit_plus; exact h_slit_plus)` and analogously for L_L via neg_zero/zero_div.
findings.issue: hL_R : L_R ≠ 0 is redundant. h_slit_plus : (γ (t₀+r) - s)/L_R ∈ slitPlane already forces L_R ≠ 0, since L_R = 0 gives (…)/0 = 0 ∉ slitPlane (Complex.zero_notMem_slitPlane). Likewise hL_L : L_L ≠ 0 is implied by h_slit_minus : (-L_L)/(γ (t₀-r) - s) ∈ slitPlane (L_L = 0 ⇒ -L_L = 0 ⇒ 0/… = 0 ∉ slitPlane).

findings.evidence: PerWindowCPV.lean:119-137 uses hl/hu only to restrict window hypotheses to [l,u]; LogDerivFTC.lean:92-96 takes hypotheses on uIcc a b directly.
findings.fix: State it directly on [l,u]: ContinuousOn γ (Icc l u), ∀ t ∈ Ioo l u \ P, DifferentiableAt, IntervalIntegrable (deriv γ) l u; drop t₀, r, hl, hu, hlu. Callers already have the window facts and can restrict.
findings.issue: annular_log_diff_window assumes hγ_cont/hγ_diffP/hderiv_int over the whole window [t₀-r, t₀+r] (via t₀, r, hl, hu) but only integrates over [l,u] ⊆ window; the wrapped integral_inv_sub_mul_deriv_eq_log takes its hypotheses on the integration interval itself (LogDerivFTC.lean:92-96). Stronger than necessary.

summary: Two hypotheses of the public theorem (hL_R, hL_L) are redundant: each is implied by the corresponding slit-plane hypothesis and should be derived internally rather than assumed.
